opening.argument: The presentation makes network building the condition for cash earnings and tells viewers that recruiting partners accelerates their earnings. It promotes OneCoin packages and describes earning through recommendations, establishing a team-based commission structure tied to expanding the network. The sales pitch also encourages token purchases with a claim that the price could increase fivefold in a year and that participants make money from that appreciation. Purchased tokens are linked to participation in mining. These claims matter together: viewers are being instructed to buy into a package system whose earning pathway depends on recruitment, with projected token appreciation supplying an additional inducement. This is an instructional sales webinar promoting participation in a recruitment-driven scam, not a warning or independent investigation.
